sloka: प्रासादाः पर्वताकाराः पतन्ति धरणीतले।अगरुर्दह्यते तत्र वर च हरिचन्दनम् ।। ६.७५.७ ।।
transliteration: prāsādāḥ parvatākārāḥ patanti dharaṇītale।agarurdahyate tatra vara ca haricandanam ।। 6.75.7 ।।

translations.english: Then thousands of their houses were burnt by fire (consumer of offerings), and mountain like mansions collapsed to the ground.
